purpose: Canonical trace for discovery -> scientific impact -> consequence -> derived work, including contradiction and dependency review.

distinctions.GAP: Missing or defective element required by an already-known specification, contract or requirement.
distinctions.DISCOVERY: New information that changes or may change knowledge, architecture, hypothesis, validation, interpretation or decision.
distinctions.rule: Do not convert GAP into DISCOVERY or DISCOVERY into GAP without a justified semantic change.

derived_work_rule: Create or update work only when a material scientific or technical consequence exists and no equivalent work already represents it.
